title: Minimum tax on discretionary trusts
summary: A 30 per cent minimum tax on certain discretionary trust distributions from 1 July 2028 (announced in the 2026-27 Budget). Aims to make the tax system fairer and more sustainable. Does not apply to other types of trusts; some income types excluded.
notes: Treasury consultation closed 31 Jul 2026 (opened 8 Jul 2026). Feedback sought on: (1) expanded rollover relief to support restructuring - trusts restructuring can access expanded rollover relief for 3 years from 1 July 2027; (2) treatment of excess franking credits; (3) ways to collect the minimum tax. Consultation paper: PDF 1.14 MB / DOCX 382 KB on the consultation page. Contact: mintaxtrusts@treasury.gov.au. Legislation not yet introduced.
